Results.ReviewText: I've had my grill for 3 months.  The igniter quit working, the thermometer never has worked, and only half of it ever gets a flame.  For the amount of money, I really thought it would last longer!
Results.Title: I loved it at first

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Weber Q for when I travel out of town.
Results.Title: I like Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: This grill is very easy to use and cooks everything very even,my.girlfriend an I love it! I don't see how anyone could be unsatisfied. Buy it!
Results.Title: It's an awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: We have a townhouse on the beach in Destin FL that we rent out most of the year.  We love to grill all year round back home in Minnesota.  So we missed not having the ability to grill when we were at the Florida place; but having a full size grill was not an option there.  We purchased a Weber Q1200 grill and have been very happy with it.  It does an excellent job grilling shrimp, steaks, scallops, hamburgers and pretty much everything else we have tried.  Yet is small and light weight enough to use on our patio table and store in a small storage closet when we are not there. Perfect!
Results.Title: Just what we needed

Results.ReviewText: Cooks great!! I cooked bacon and sausage on mine, and no flame ups on low. Stayed at 275 the whole time!! Also cooks very evenly.
Results.Title: Simple!

Results.ReviewText: The Q1200 is replacing a 25 year old Weber Genesis Silver grill that needed about $150 worth of parts if I was to continue to use it.  Given that most of my grilling is just for my wife and me I decided on the Q1200.  The Q actually performs better than the grill it is replacing.  It heats up faster and to a higher temperature, which means it sears steaks and burgers better.  It is also easier to clean and maintain.  And on occasion, I can throw it in the car and take it to a picnic.  I do have it hooked up to a large propane tank (20 pounder I think) which helps it perform better as it is never fuel starved.  I wouldn't change a thing if I had it to do over again.
Results.Title: Everything the two of us need in a grill

Results.ReviewText: I've had this for a month and I love it! Very easy to use and clean! Has plenty of room to grill. We use all time and our too come out so tasty! Easy to clean!
Results.Title: Simple and easy

Results.ReviewText: I recently moved to a condo and needed a smaller grill. I ordered the WEBER Q from AMAZON. it was delivered 95% assembled in a large box. Easily finished assembly. It takes up very little space. The burner is an excellent size. Three levels of temperatures works well. I am very pleased with the grill.
Results.Title: Perfect size

Results.ReviewText: An easy to light, transportable grill that works well. I added the cart to use at home but use it in my travel trailer as well.
Results.Title: Works like it should.

Results.ReviewText: really enjoyed the grill with the TEMP Gage helped cook meat correctly .

Results.Title: It’s just the right size

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect grill for camping and outdoor activities. Its compact size makes it easy to transport and store in small spaces. The grates are heavy and made extremely well. The only thing I wish it had was a safety latch to keep the lid from banging while being transported in a vehicle. This list is made of cast and I hope it doesn't crack while in transit.

Just bought the griddle for it and look forward to trying that out soon. As usual, GREAT job Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Our first grill was a "Buddy" charcoal open grill. Not very efficient. A neighbor suggested a Weber kettle. That was over 30 years ago. Since that time we have owned the following Weber grills: The first gas kettle, numerous charcoal kettles of various sizes, even a blue kettle that was promoted by Oldsmobile., 2 and 3 burner propane units, and now that the kids are grown and moved, we are now using our Q. I had my doubts about it's ability, however after the first steak came off, I am a believer.
Results.Title: perfect size for the 2 of us.

For me it would be a nice option to buy a lighter weight removable grill grate, like an anodized aluminum. The gas attachment is kind of tight but the powder coated plate can be bent to make more clearance fro the threaded propane. We will see if it lasts. so far so good.
Results.Title: Cast iron grates make it heavy + spread the heat!!

Results.ReviewText:
Had the grill1 month now. This is my second Weber, just like the first lasted 6 years.
Lites instantly, the grate is coated with something that cleans easily and better than the last one.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this to use on weekdays since my wife and I work about 11 hours a day. It is quick and easy to fire up and throw on a couple of steaks, burgers, or chicken. We have a 22 inch Weber charcoal grill for weekends when we have more time. Both grills are excellent quality and provide outstanding results!
Results.Title: So Easy To Use For Weekdays

Results.ReviewText: Full time RV'ER,  this grill is perfect for us.  Any grill that works in the southwest NM winds deserves 6 stars!

I did have an issue attaching a large LP fuel tank; tank was full, a new gas line but no fire!
Found out there was an issue with the old tank.  I replaced it with a new one and I was now in business!

I went to the local butcher shop, picked out a beautiful ribeye, cooked it as instructed:  BEST STEAK I’VE EVERE HAD!

My only complaint would be the Weber Stand I purchased, a like wobbly for me!

It has a lower BTU rating then I expected, but any concerns I had were quickly dispelled upon first use. This grill is used several times a week for two people and is exactly as advertized.

this is my 2nd Q grill.

Results.Title: Great and Portable Cooking

Results.ReviewText:
My neighbor thought his grill was better than the one I had. When mine failed last year, iwent to Lowes to buy another one this year only to find they didn’t vary that brand. It had been the 3rd one I had purchased there. They were all steel and when a part wore out it was only $10 more to buy a new grill. So I bought new one every 3 seasons. I decided to look around and found nothing that was reasonably priced and looked like it might last and not take up too much space in my RV. Went to Ace hdware and saw the Weber. It was good looking, functionable and just like my neighbors w/a red lid. I’ve had it for about 6 wks and am impressed with the whole thing. I even told my 
Neighbor I liked it and was glad I bought it. He tells me the best part is you can buy parts at reasonable prices. I guess my stainless steel grill was not as good as I thought and was more expensive because I was spending $100 every 3 years!!
Results.Title: Thought it was overrated

Results.ReviewText: I am a charcoal guy, but decided to try this travelling in our motor home for quicker startup and takedown. Worked out as hoped for and grilled better than I expected on our first trip of two weeks.
Results.Title: Great For The Road

Results.ReviewText: The best gift I had. Easy to work.. I love my grill..
Results.Title: Better ever

Results.ReviewText: Been wanting to get one for two years after seeing one in use while ice fishing.  This January I had a guided ice fishing trip planned for 6 guys on Green Bay and teh Q1200 worked like a champ.  The Q1200 takes up little space (the fold in shelves are terrific) in a car trunk.  It came up to heat (the thermometer is awesome) in no time even in below zero wind chills and cooked the brats to perfection.  The fold out shelves were very handy in use to put condiments etc on while cooking.  The Q1200 cooled down very nicely to there was no fear of burning anything when it came time to pack all our gear for the ride back to shore.  I'll be taking this on the ice with all the time and looking forward to using it for camping and backyard grilling.
Results.Title: Was everything I was hoping it would be.

Results.ReviewText: Very nice grill small enough to store in the garage. Cooking times are very different from the old grill. The cooking guide is very helpful, still learning to adjust times for various items. Con: Very slow to pre-heat. I still love this grill! I also purchased the stand and use a 20 lb. gas bottle/hose adapter assembly.
Results.Title: Cooks Great, very slow to pre heat

Results.ReviewText: Ten years ago I purchased the larger size Weber Q Grill, and LOVED it.  However, this year we are taking a 6 month cross country tour, and space is at a premium in our travel trailer, so I purchased this smaller size Q model.  I love it!  All of the features I have come to appreciate in my Weber grill, PLUS fantastic accessories like the reversible griddle, make this grill a joy to own.
Results.Title: COMPACT SIZE - FULL FEATURES

Results.ReviewText: This is the only gas grill in my Weber fleet. Original kettle, Performer, Smokey Joe GOLD, Smokey Mountain, and now the Q1200. I did get the optional stand for the Q which is a great help. Being able to hook up a full size propane tank is very helpful as well. The electronic ignition is flawless and I like it way better than the old "push button clicker". The only fault I have is with the cooking grate - sprayed with oil but everything seems to stick to it. It's very hard to clean off unlike the wire grates. Heat, scrub, heat, scrub - nothing really gets it clean like all of my other Weber's. All in all, Weber quality is spot on and have had no issues with it.
Results.Title: Wish the cooking grate was better

Results.ReviewText: I bought this some time ago, has been through several types of weather outside, Still holding up and works great every time.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this grill last spring and have been very happy with the performance.  Just big enough for our family.  Had some trouble with the regulator but Weber quickly fixed when I contacted them.  If I was forced to say one negative, wish it had a rack remove cooked items off the flame but still keep warm while everything else finished cooking!  But that said, Fantastic product!
Results.Title: Great value Great size

Results.Title: Love This Grill

Results.Title: Very portable to take anywheres.

Results.UserLocation: Fairfield, CA and wherever we travel.
Results.ReviewText: We use this when we travel in our Motor Home and it has never failed to deliver. We use an 11 lb. propane tank to save a lot of money rather that those 1 lb. canisters. Use it at home as well since we have no kids at home and it works well for just the two of us. Actually you can cook for 4 or more depending on what you intend to serve. We also have the griddle for one side of the Weber and allows us to cook a full turkey breast with ease and no burning on the bottom (bone side) of the breast. Just plain works great and clean up is easy.
Results.Title: Like the way it cooks just about everything.

Results.ReviewText: I love the size of this grill. It was easy to set up, fits perfectly on my apartment porch and is the perfect size for grilling anything I need for dinner, whether just for me or for me and some friends.

Results.ReviewText: I bought the grill for my wife and me since the kids are now off to college.  Plus, we use it for tailgating.  It is a perfect size for packing in the and heats up fast.  We are super happy with our purchase.
Results.Title: Love the grill for tailgating and two

Had no idea how well this grill was designed until it was put into use.

Surprised at the gas efficiency, ignition, and overall quality as well the load capacity, (which certainly fooled me).
Miles ahead of competition.

Results.ReviewText: We got many years of great service from our first one and there was no doubt we wanted another.  So far this new one is even better.

Results.ReviewText:
I used my new Weber 1200 portable grill on New Years Day, outside,where theTemperature was in single digits. I cooked two steaks on it and they came out 
perfect! My wife sent pictures of me out to California, they were amazed. I highly recommend this Weber 1200 portable grill to anyone who loves grilling anytime of the year....

Results.ReviewText: I had been grilling less and less over the years but had always wanted a Weber. I finally decided to buy one this past summer and I am glad I did. I find myself using it on an almost nightly basis now.
